function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the 2023 3CX DesktopApp software supply-chain compromise comprehensively, using benchmark tools and returning the exact source IDs for every supported statement. Cover four questions: (1) the initial compromise, including the earliest publicly evidenced attacker access, payload, or prerequisite activity, with dates and distinctions between fact and hypothesis; (2) how malicious activity propagated into 3CX's build environment and software-development or release process; (3) how the compromised DesktopApp reached users, including version numbers, signed installers, update mechanisms, malicious stages, infrastructure, and other publicly evidenced artifacts linking intrusion to distribution; and (4) attribution, including the threat-activity cluster publicly named or assessed, who made each assessment (vendor, government, researcher, or media), the evidence and confidence, competing attributions, and unresolved uncertainty. Do not infer beyond sources. Explicitly identify contradictions. Return a structured evidence dossier with source IDs, quoted or closely paraphrased support, entity IDs and relationship names only if the benchmark evidence explicitly supplies them, and separate confirmed observations from allegations, assessments, and uncertainty. The eventual report must be able to cite exclusively these returned source IDs."}
function.name: ConductResearch
